decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix sits far from the firm's engineering and waste-conversion knowledge base, so its R&D and university cooperation give little absorptive advantage for interpreting and improving it.
Modular extensions to the waste-to-energy plants build directly on the firm's core engineering and prototyping competence, letting it learn from deployments and refine the models.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant is a flagship grounded in the firm's established WASTX technology, where in-house R&D and research cooperation give strong capacity to assimilate feedback and improve it.
The plastic-to-fuel plant extends the firm's related conversion know-how and is a strategic focus, so the firm can absorb early results and develop it further despite its higher technical risk.
